written_before_tuning: This file, with every rule below, was committed before any v2 tuning code or run existed.
ticket_scope: Part of the v2 refinement work under AL-257. Nothing here changes the frozen v1 model or its final test.
inputs: The five inputs plus the Eircode routing key.
training_rows: Development rows plus the calibration rows that have a floor area (the 80%), chosen by the more-rows test (more_rows_config.json). The final test is not read.
scored_rows: The same 4,882 development rows in the same five group folds. Calibration rows are only ever training rows. Each fold trains on the other four development folds plus all calibration rows.

reference.what: The v1 tuned settings with the Eircode key on the 80%, from the more-rows test.
reference.rule: Use the best tuned settings if they are lower in CV MAPE than the v1 settings (min_gain_pp 0), otherwise keep the v1 settings.

search: Random search, one seeded draw per trial, every trial scored on the same five folds. The same search spaces as the v1 tuning.

ensemble_mean.what: Equal-weight average of the three models' predictions in log-price, from their out-of-fold predictions. No weights are learned. Uses each model's chosen settings (tuned, or the v1 settings if tuning did not beat them).
ensemble_mean.not_included: Seed bagging is not used: it added under 0.2 points for roughly ten times the fitting time (v2_models_config.json results).

winner_rule.rule: The contender with the lowest CV MAPE wins (an exact tie goes to the simplest, in simplicity_order), provided it passes the bias check.
winner_rule.bias_check: A contender is excluded if its median over or under estimate is outside plus or minus 2%, so it cannot win by estimating low.
winner_rule.also_report: MdAPE, within 10%, MAE, R2, the fold spread, and fit and predict time.

after_tuning: The chosen model is frozen as v2 in ml/reports/v2-frozen-model.json. v2 then gets its own accuracy threshold and price range from out-of-fold predictions and one final test, under rules committed first.
changed_before_the_real_run: On 20 Oct 2026, after a 2-trial smoke test (not the real run), the owner dropped the 1-point tie band and the 0.3-point reference rule: the aim is the lowest error. Now the lowest CV MAPE wins, using the best settings found, as long as the bias check passes.
